searchText: any progress towards PR 2149? Was PR 2149 suppose to go in HF1? HF2? PR 2149 doesn't require changes to the beacon chain, so merging it seems decoupled from HF1/HF2/etc. It does seem like discussion here (and on the PR) has stalled. i suspect that getting the 0x01 withdrawal cred commitment in the spec is worth doing now with an understanding that withdrawal creds that can trigger withdrawal (i.e. 0x02 option <@!291925846556540928> mentioned above) can be decoupled into a future spec update does anyone feel differently? Yeah, I was just looking at this again today. Sorry I've gotten general support when reaching out but a few negative feedbacks. IMO, 0x01 functionality is *very* similar to 0x00 functionality (that is, 0x00 key will have to sign a message specifying an eth1 addr for ultimate withdrawal) so the code paths to support this additional credential are minimal I also think that 80% of interesting usecases can be built out today and the remaining 20% that need more advanced features like reading of beacon chain state (e.g. is validator slashed?) can wait until later development note, 0x01 can even be used when beacon cahin state can be read with new conditionals in how withdrawn funds are dsitributed (obviously can't plan for how beacon state is read today so it would be jsut for future uses) as for anything more advanced like eth1 triggering exits and things, we can't reasonably plan for that today so must be deferred i think there's slight nuance here as 0x01 creds (if they're eth1 addresses) can be interpreted by smart contracts built in eth1 *today*. i.e. don't require a contract in eth1 validating a bls sig so 0x01 I think is as good as it gets today and as I mentioned has very similar logic as 0x00 so isn't a terrible increase in legacy support yes, of course. there are plenty of things you can do with 0x01's today so I think it's worth it I'm just saying, that on beacon chain, there wil probably be a "set withdrawal destination addr" operation that 0x00 creds wil sign it's the difference b/w being able vs not being able to compose functionality on withdrawal contracts today in eth1 and once that is done, the withdrawal of 0x00 and 0x01 looks the same I talk about how these two things ultimately are similar here -- https://ethresear.ch/t/simple-eth1-withdrawals-beacon-chain-centric/8256/ similar in that beacon chain logic paths are similar. not in that the practical functionality for users is the same right is there any additional research/spec-ing you think should be done before merging the 0x01 pr? I'm opening the PR right now why don't you do a final pass as well yep, on it <@291925846556540928> 0x01 is only for newly deposited validators? How would we go about changing existing validators from 0x0 to 0x01? Will that require some changes to the beacon spec? practically, there will be an operation in the future to allow for 0x00 validators to sign a message to specify the destination eth1 address. This could happen either in the beacon chain or when a withdrawal proof is being consumed in eth1 (assuming efficient bls in the EVM). I lean toward beacon chain side, but that doesn't matter too much here. With the simple release of 0x01, it would not allow for any new functionality for already deployed 0x00 creds today. It would only open up new functionality for newly submitted validators Understood. Would you expect being able to change existing validators happen after the merge? Or maybe sooner say in HF1/2? not in HF1. Merge might be next fork after The specification of the destination eth1 addr functionality for 0x00 is primarily there for withdrawals so I would assume that is addressed then. Got it. Thanks! There are a lot of people in the Rocket Pool server currently spamming F5 on this PR page right now lol maybe they can bring down github Thank you Danny and co 👍 wooot wooot I guess <@!405158743920345128> finally let you out of the basement 😆 Thanks Danny cheers! thank <@!345680403052625930> 🤣 <@!345680403052625930> 🙏 haha anytime Thanks <@!291925846556540928> and <@!345680403052625930> for all your hard work guys, we'll put it to great use! <:simpsonhappy:405668432147775488>

excerpts.content: any progress towards PR 2149?

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content: Was PR 2149 suppose to go in HF1? HF2?

excerpts.author: lsankar
excerpts.content: PR 2149 doesn't require changes to the beacon chain, so merging it seems decoupled from HF1/HF2/etc.

excerpts.author: lsankar
excerpts.content:
It does seem like discussion here (and on the PR) has stalled. i suspect that getting the 0x01 withdrawal cred commitment in the spec is worth doing now with an understanding that withdrawal creds that can trigger withdrawal (i.e. 0x02 option <@!291925846556540928> mentioned above) can be decoupled into a future spec update

does anyone feel differently?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
Yeah, I was just looking at this again today. Sorry I've gotten general support when reaching out but a few negative feedbacks.

IMO, 0x01 functionality is *very* similar to 0x00 functionality (that is, 0x00 key will have to sign a message specifying an eth1 addr for ultimate withdrawal) so the code paths to support this additional credential are minimal

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
I also think that 80% of interesting usecases can be built out today and the remaining 20% that need more advanced features like reading of beacon chain state (e.g. is validator slashed?) can wait until later development

note, 0x01 can even be used when beacon cahin state can be read with new conditionals in how withdrawn funds are dsitributed

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: (obviously can't plan for how beacon state is read today so it would be jsut for future uses)

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: as for anything more advanced like eth1 triggering exits and things, we can't reasonably plan for that today so must be deferred

excerpts.author: lsankar
excerpts.content: i think there's slight nuance here as 0x01 creds (if they're eth1 addresses) can be interpreted by smart contracts built in eth1 *today*. i.e. don't require a contract in eth1 validating a bls sig

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: so 0x01 I think is as good as it gets today and as I mentioned has very similar logic as 0x00 so isn't a terrible increase in legacy support

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: yes, of course. there are plenty of things you can do with 0x01's today so I think it's worth it

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: I'm just saying, that on beacon chain, there wil probably be a "set withdrawal destination addr" operation that 0x00 creds wil sign

excerpts.author: lsankar
excerpts.content: it's the difference b/w being able vs not being able to compose functionality on withdrawal contracts today in eth1

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: and once that is done, the withdrawal of 0x00 and 0x01 looks the same

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
I talk about how these two things ultimately are similar here -- https://ethresear.ch/t/simple-eth1-withdrawals-beacon-chain-centric/8256/

similar in that beacon chain logic paths are similar. not in that the practical functionality for users is the same

excerpts.author: lsankar
excerpts.content: right

excerpts.author: lsankar
excerpts.content: is there any additional research/spec-ing you think should be done before merging the 0x01 pr?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
I'm opening the PR right now
why don't you do a final pass as well

excerpts.author: lsankar
excerpts.content: yep, on it

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content: <@291925846556540928> 0x01 is only for newly deposited validators? How would we go about changing existing validators from 0x0 to 0x01? Will that require some changes to the beacon spec?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
practically, there will be an operation in the future to allow for 0x00 validators to sign a message to specify the destination eth1 address. This could happen either in the beacon chain or when a withdrawal proof is being consumed in eth1 (assuming efficient bls in the EVM). I lean toward beacon chain side, but that doesn't matter too much here.

With the simple release of 0x01, it would not allow for any new functionality for already deployed 0x00 creds today. It would only open up new functionality for newly submitted validators

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content: Understood. Would you expect being able to change existing validators happen after the merge? Or maybe sooner say in HF1/2?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
not in HF1.

Merge might be next fork after

The specification of the destination eth1 addr functionality for 0x00  is primarily there for withdrawals so I would assume that is addressed then.

excerpts.content: Got it. Thanks!
